messages.subject: Capacity of mirt()  function
parts:
Hi,
 
I'm using the function mirt() to analyze a large data set (about 1200 columns and  1.5 millions of rows)  and i have a question about the capacity of the function and package, i mean, has it a limit of rows and columns to be included in the analysis?  (considering that i have a super powerful computer to do it, but i don't know if that's enough)

thanks!

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Capacity of mirt() function
parts:
The only limitation is going to be how much RAM you have, and how long you are willing to wait. 1200 items is quite a huge number, and combine that with 1.5 million observations means that things are going to take a while. You might want to look into the 'large' argument in mirt to save some pre-processing time if you plan to run multiple models with this dataset. HTH.

Phil
